layout_spacing.grid_lookbook: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-12 sm:gap-24 items-center

motion_interactions.opening_animation: Layered SVG path-draw animations simulating Sumi-e brushstrokes painting the YIRUDA wordmark and tagline over ~4 seconds. Use framer-motion with ease: [0.25, 1, 0.5, 1]. Sequence: Background stroke -> Wordmark strokes -> Fade in email signup form.
motion_interactions.cursor_trail: HTML5 Canvas full-screen overlay (pointer-events: none). Track mouse moves, draw connected curves using bezier paths with fading opacity and varying stroke width (pressure simulation) to look like bleeding ink.
motion_interactions.glitch_effect: Every 8 seconds, the Pink Octopus image is instantly swapped to the Green Octopus image for 200ms-400ms accompanied by a swift horizontal paintbrush sweep animation overlay.
motion_interactions.hover_states: Buttons use border-accent_crimson or bg-text_primary with text-background. Subtle scale up on lookbook images.

components.buttons: Flat rectangles, no rounded corners. 1px solid border (ink black or crimson). Transparent bg defaulting to ink black on hover. Uppercase, wide tracking.
components.inputs: Shadcn input customized to have only a bottom border (border-b border-text_primary), no background, no ring, focus-visible outline none. Classic paper form aesthetic.
components.lookbook_layout: Asymmetric editorial layout. Do not center everything. Product 1 (Octopus) spans md:col-span-7, Notify Me form md:col-span-5. Product 2 (Lotus) spans md:col-start-6 md:col-span-7, Notify form md:col-span-4. Generous negative space.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install `framer-motion` for brushstroke animations and the octopus glitch effect.
Implement the cursor ink trail using a custom Canvas component. Store previous mouse points and draw curved strokes that fade out over time.
The landing page must start with the 4-second brushstroke reveal of 'YIRUDA', and then fade in an email capture form (only storing in MongoDB, no complex auth). Use a minimalist form style.
Create a dedicated 'Drops' page routing via react-router-dom.
On the Drops page, layout the two products using an asymmetric grid. For each product, include a 'Notify me' email input.

Implement the 8-second interval glitch on the Octopus image: use a setInterval or framer-motion useAnimation to briefly swap the image source to 'product_octopus_green' with a brushstroke SVG sweep overlay.
Apply Hanji paper texture visually: Use the cream background color and perhaps a very subtle SVG noise overlay if possible.
Remember to include `data-testid` attributes on forms and buttons.
Ensure global navigation exists to switch between Landing and Drops.
Use JS (not TSX) files for all React components.
